name: Nuevo León

standard.note: Nuevo León's current plate, rolled out in 2023, carries the state's 'Nuevo León' wordmark plus the state and national coats of arms.

plates.title: Current design (2023)
plates.fact: Nuevo León's current plate, rolled out in 2023, carries the state's 'Nuevo León' wordmark plus the state and national coats of arms.

plates.title: FIFA World Cup 2026 commemorative
plates.fact: Monterrey hosted World Cup matches, and Nuevo León released a limited run of about 40,000 World Cup plates in March 2026, priced the same as regular plates.

plates.title: Drivers with disabilities
plates.fact: About 1,500 people a year get Nuevo León's disability plates, and the first set is free.

plates.title: Eco vehicles (green leaf)
plates.source: https://www.google.com/search?q=placas+site%3Anl.gob.mx&udm=2 (subasta.nl.gob.mx 'Ficha técnica de placas' PDF shows a plate with a green leaf)

notes: The 2011 design ('Nuevo León Unido') lost validity on July 1, 2023 (ICV, via unotv). The official March 4, 2026 bulletin (robot_url) has only photos of officials holding the World Cup and disability plates, which aren't allowed, so no image was used. Plate artwork exists only in subasta.nl.gob.mx tender PDFs (2_949.pdf, 2_1148.pdf). The year 2023 comes from UnoTV's 2025 roundup ('redesigned in 2023'). The eco plate is seen only in a spec PDF.
